text: The doctor had such a gentle touch, I didn’t even feel her take my blood. Thank you!
This is my 3rd time being here. It’s almost painless compared to other major hospitals I’ve been to before.

Clinical laboratory located in the center of Phuket town offers you blood tests in 30 minutes at an excellent price! The staff treats you very well and painlessly when they draw blood. I recommend this Laboratory if you need blood tests for a driver's license or work permit. Enjoy Phuket! Enjoy Thailand!

I don't recommend this clinic. Initially, I was quoted a fixed price for all tests, but three days after receiving some of the results, I was informed that I would have to pay extra for additional tests. I consider this change in terms after I donated blood to be unfair.
The staff provided good service and the prices were affordable 👍 …
